basic_info.description: Welcome to 655 Frederick Street, a bright top-floor unit located in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods. The living room features soaring ceilings and corner, southern exposure looking out towards Sutro Tower. The dining area opens to a private, south-facing deck that enjoys all day sun. The updated kitchen includes an electric range, built-in microwave, dishwasher and large sink. In the bedroom there is a bay window, a large closet, and an ensuite bath. A private laundry room and large garage with additional storage area complete this property. The location, surrounded by Cole Valley's innumerable amenities, is one of the best in the city. Golden Gate Park, Kezar Stadium, the N-Judah, UCSF, Luke's Local, Zazie and Sutro Forest all are just moments away.   Please note: Property is subject to resale procedures under the City Second Loan Program. The City and County of San Francisco holds the right of first refusal to purchase the property, and any offer is contingent on such rights. The City Second Loan Program is available for qualified buyers on a first-come, first-served basis through the San Francisco Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development. Visit https://sfmohcd.org/city-second-details for application and program information.
